MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person) WITH i,p RETURN DISTINCT i.issueKey AS k, p.personKey AS pk UNION MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 RETURN DISTINCT i.issueKey AS k, p.personKey AS pk
MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person) WITH DISTINCT i,p RETURN i,p UNION MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 RETURN DISTINCT i,p

CALL () { MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person) RETURN i,p UNION MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 RETURN i,p }
WITH i, collect(DISTINCT p) ps WHERE size(ps)>=2
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
UNWIND ps AS p
WITH collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS people, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS projs
UNWIND ([x IN people | {id:x, kind:'person'}] + [x IN projs | {id:x, kind:'project'}]) AS r
RETURN r.id AS id, r.kind AS kind
